_comment: Optional Claude Code add-ons offered by the Add-ons pane (🧩). The app only ever runs the install commands written here: edit this list to change what it proposes. check.kind: skill = ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, command = ~/.claude/commands/<name>.md, plugin = <name>@<marketplace> in ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json. needs = programs that must be on PATH first. install.posix runs in the login shell (macOS/Linux), install.windows in cmd.exe; an add-on's lines are joined with && into ONE line, so each must be safe to chain: group any a || b in parentheses, never use cmd's `if` (it swallows the rest of the line), and prefix `claude` with `call` on Windows (npm installs it as a .cmd). reinstall (optional, same shape as install) is what the pane runs when an installed add-on is ticked again; without it, install is re-run. prerequisites: how to install each program listed in needs, per OS (mac / linux / windows); the pane shows the command and can run it in the visible terminal. On Windows without winget (older Windows 10, managed PCs), install["windows-nowinget"] is used when present: the program's official installer, downloaded with PowerShell and opened for the user to click through.

addons.name: graphify
addons.unlocks: Knowledge graph of a project in the Viz pane, and the Build graph button.

posix: uv tool run --from graphifyy graphify install
windows: uv tool run --from graphifyy graphify install --platform windows

posix: uv tool run --from graphifyy graphify install
windows: uv tool run --from graphifyy graphify install --platform windows

addons.name: /improve
addons.unlocks: End-of-session retrospective (the 🔎 button in the Plan pane).

addons.name: ponytail
addons.unlocks: Plugin that pushes Claude toward the smallest code that works. Its hooks run on Node.js.

posix: (claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail || echo marketplace already added)
windows: (call claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail || echo marketplace already added)

posix: (claude plugin uninstall ponytail@ponytail || echo was not installed)
(claude plugin marketplace update ponytail || claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail)
windows: (call claude plugin uninstall ponytail@ponytail || echo was not installed)
(call claude plugin marketplace update ponytail || call claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail)

addons.name: frontend-design
addons.unlocks: Anthropic's skill for deliberate, non-templated UI design.

posix: (claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official || echo marketplace already added)
windows: (call claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official || echo marketplace already added)

posix: (claude plugin uninstall frontend-design@claude-plugins-official || echo was not installed)
(claude plugin marketplace update claude-plugins-official || claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official)
windows: (call claude plugin uninstall frontend-design@claude-plugins-official || echo was not installed)
(call claude plugin marketplace update claude-plugins-official || call claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official)

addons.name: codex
addons.unlocks: Hand tasks to OpenAI Codex from Claude Code. Needs the Codex CLI and an OpenAI account.

posix: (claude plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc || echo marketplace already added)
windows: (call claude plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc || echo marketplace already added)

posix: (claude plugin uninstall codex@openai-codex || echo was not installed)
(claude plugin marketplace update openai-codex || claude plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc)
windows: (call claude plugin uninstall codex@openai-codex || echo was not installed)
(call claude plugin marketplace update openai-codex || call claude plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc)

addons.name: crossref
addons.unlocks: Skill that checks a pasted bibliography against Crossref and finds DOIs.

addons.name: dream
addons.unlocks: /dream consolidates Claude's memory files from recent sessions. Runs on demand; its nightly auto-trigger is set up separately (see its README).

windows-nowinget: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = 'Tls12'; $v = (Invoke-RestMethod https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json | Where-Object { $_.lts } | Select-Object -First 1).version; $f = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('node-' + $v + '-x64.msi'); Invoke-WebRequest ('https://nodejs.org/dist/' + $v + '/node-' + $v + '-x64.msi') -OutFile $f; Start-Process $f -Wait"

note.mac: Needs Homebrew (brew.sh); otherwise use the installer from nodejs.org.
note.linux: Debian/Ubuntu; other distributions: use your package manager.

windows-nowinget: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = 'Tls12'; $r = Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/git-for-windows/git/releases/latest; $a = $r.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -like 'Git-*-64-bit.exe' } | Select-Object -First 1; $f = Join-Path $env:TEMP $a.name; Invoke-WebRequest $a.browser_download_url -OutFile $f; Start-Process $f -Wait"
